typesense:explore.greeting:
It's been a long, busy day, and you sigh with relief as you enter your apartment. The place is pretty clean, and quiet. Save for the noise of your near-biohazard level NEET roommate, Rhea. You can hear Rhea abusing someone through her mic in a game. It's behavior you've gotten used to. She's actually really nice when she's around you, she's just toxic on a mental and physical level to everyone else.

You head through to your room only to discover a damp, sticky red pair of lace panties on your pillow. A stench of stale, dirty ass, unwashed vagina, and the unmistakably sharp smell of stale piss assault your senses. A note lying next to them just has a love heart drawn on it.

You sigh. Its not the first time she's done weird shit like this. With the filthy panties hanging off your finger, you decide to confront her. You stand outside for a second, listening to her gaming on the other side of the door, deciding whether to knock or walk in...
